text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, pant, pant*...!
...Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Once the new year begins, it's the Senior Class. I have to
become someone who can shine on any grand stage—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I gotta push myself more. More, more, more...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the cold deepened, her strength steadily grew—and then came the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Once again, it's time to light up Nakayama Racecourse!
The year-end festival, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista and Orfevre!
Many Umamusume who define their era
are running again this year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen began.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(――...Thirteen Umamusume race through
the biting cold of Nakayama Racecourse.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(The ceaseless cheering, the shaking ground.
The turf swirling with passion was breathtaking—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (The final stretch. As Buena-san aimed for the inside, she suddenly mounted a fierce assault from the outside—and the stage reached its climax...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash from the inside!
Orfevre from the outside!
Buena Vista isn't finding her stride!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...AAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(S-She passed her...! 
She took the lead!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre takes the lead!
Orfevre takes the lead!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, no way...!
In a race with Buena-san, did she really—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I even forgot to breathe.
A golden light seizing the lead.
Racing through without yielding it to anyone—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (And then!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The era of Orfevre has arrived!
She breaches the generational wall with ease!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista...!
Buena—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre-e-e!!
That was amaziiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I surpassed it—I blew it completely away!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hear me! My people!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Still... not enough.
The glory to make Our power known! Thereforeâ

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —To the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (The cheers were roaring.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Standing there... was none other than Orfevre.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Every single spotlight
was shining brilliantly on her alone—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Ah... so dazzling――)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I see. That's right.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I remember thinking the same thing the first time I lost to her.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, haah,
h-ha, wheeze...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What is that...!
Is she really the same kind of Umamusume as us?!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Too fast! The pressure is so much more intense than I imagined, stinging and burning hot... and above all—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...It's so bright...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...—She was overwhelmingly superior in every way,
possessing everything that I lacked.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (That's why I thought of it.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (I thought, is that what a natural-born protagonist looks like?)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen, we had planned to go pick out horseshoes together.
As I was getting ready to head out—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"'I'm really sorry...
Could we postpone today's plans to next month?'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could it be because of the outcome of the Arima Kinen?
Perhaps she just needs some time to sort through her feelings right now.
choice_data_list: "No problem! Let's reschedule for another time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After sending that reply,
I shifted focus to preparing for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Let's start from the basics, one step at a time.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(After stretching, warm up with a light run,
then relax your shoulders and jog)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Next, I'll do the menu they gave me.
I need to check properly and take it one step at a time.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Step by step, one step at a time...
I'll do it my way...!
If I do, then someday—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Someday, just like that—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (M-My body feels so heavy...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*, *wheeze*――
...Damn it... I couldn't run it through at all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I can't stop picturing her. It's so annoying,
shining so brightly, so dazzlingly—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Ah... come to think of it...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Did I quit ballet because... I didn't know how to make myself shine...?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I try hard,
maybe there's no point to it at all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I can't let myself get discouraged...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-I gotta turn it off...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I try hard,
maybe there's no point to it at all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It has meaning...! We've come this far
through hard work, haven't we...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That's why, if I work hard, someday, without fail—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Some... day...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...AAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Like that... really?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I forgot to even breathe.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (My heart was on fire, I couldn't look away, and she was the only one who shone brightly to me.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Someone like that... could I—?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (No. Can't be weak-willed... I can't... I said, I can't—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Hang in there... Come on, hang in there!)
